summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it has begun receiving QCAD deposits under a stablecoin custody services agreement with Stablecorp, and congratulating Stablecorp on listing QCAD on Kraken. No financial terms, stake, price, or premium were disclosed. The press release describes the start of deposit flows as incremental income from the bank's digital asset strategy. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics associated with a special situation. This is a routine business update on a custody agreement and exchange listing, not a special-situation event.
